name: Gokshura
actions: Traditionally used as a tonic for the urinary and reproductive organs
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; taken as powder or decoction, or in formulations such as Gokshuradi guggulu.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: Pain or burning on passing urine needs a doctor, especially with fever.

cautions.note: Animal studies raise concern for the developing baby; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
Sold to raise hormones; avoid with hormone-sensitive conditions.

interactions.effect: Diuretic herbs can raise lithium to harmful levels.

evidence.summary: Small trials on sexual function and hormones give mixed results; not established.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
